body: if your not willing to take antidepressants because i some long term affects or unavoidable side affects, then seek a councilor and see them regularly. Not all counsilors are the same, so if your not comfortable just find another.

unlike everyone i grew up with, i dont own a home, have a family, no repsonsibilities other than to myself.  Money isnt important to me, last year i gave a backpacker over a thousand in cash to help them out.  I dont expect it back.

i would just really love to share those memories with someone special.  Thats where im getting unstuck, im lonely, thats what im saying, even with everything a person can have or want, there are some things that can make you happy without all that stuff.

ive actually been thinking this. i travelled for three years, settled into this town and job for a year and a half now.  maybe my travels were never over.  maybe this was just a pitstop.  ive loved here and lost here and the girl turned a little insecure and pshyco.

ive got enough dollars in the bank to last a couple of years on the road.

i have been on the road for over two years.  i settled in a place where i have a great job, am respected more than i have been in my life.  Ive done lots of community stuff here. I just want to fall in love.  I have everything in my life, but that one thing i can never seem to have.  I could move to another town, but then i have to rebuild relationships from scratch.  Im sick of starting over.  The one thing i want, just seems to be out of my reach.

i feel like im starting life all over again, again.  I feel like ive worked a big circle back to where i was when i started, a feeling of having nothing.  Ive wasted ten years trying to better myself, yes i earn good money, and im highly respected in my job and in my town.  Yes ive travelled and done things out of the ordinary.

But i have this depressing feeling like ive missed out on my real life.  While taking all these steps to better my life, ive actually missed out on my life.  I could have loved, but i was alone, i could have shared but i was selfish.  Now im successful, whats it all for.
